senses.gloss:
ब The twenty-third consonant of the Nāgari Alphābet, corresponding
to the letter B, and often confounded with the analogous semi-
vowel व or V, with which some grammarians consider it to be at
all times optionally interchangeable.

ब m. (बः)
 1. A name of VARUṆA.
 2. A water jar.
 3. Ocean.
 4. The
vulva.
 E. बण् to sound, &c. aff. ड ।

बा Ind.
 1. As, like.
 2. Or, either: see वा.

बा(वा)दर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Made of cotton, mf. (-रः-रा) The cotton plant.
n. (-रं)
 1. The jujube.
 2. Silk.
 3. Water.
 4. A garment made of
cotton.
 5. A conch-shell that winds from left to right.
 E. वदर
cotton, aff. अण् ।

बा(वा)दरायण m. (-णः) An epithet of Vyāsa, as the author of the Ve-
dānta Sūtra.
 E. बदर, फक् aff. of descent.
बा (वा) दरायणि m. (-णिः) An epithet of Sūka the son of Vyāsa.
